content: For optimal effectiveness, take this medication at evenly spaced intervals. It is crucial to continue taking this medication, along with other HIV medications, exactly as prescribed by your doctor. Do not alter the dosage or stop taking it, even for a short period, unless directed by your doctor. Side Effects: Diarrhea is a common side effect of this medication. If you experience diarrhea, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice on managing it, such as using anti-diarrheal medications. Other possible side effects include nausea or gas. Remember, this medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. As your immune system strengthens, it may begin to fight off pre-existing infections, potentially causing symptoms of those infections to reappear. Additionally, an overactive immune response may occur, which can happen shortly after starting HIV treatment or even months later. This medication may rarely increase blood sugar levels, potentially causing or worsening diabetes. Notify your doctor immediately if you experience symptoms of high blood sugar, such as increased thirst or urination. If you already have diabetes, monitor your blood sugar levels regularly as directed and share the results with your doctor. Changes in body fat distribution may occur while taking this medication, such as increased fat in the upper back and stomach areas or decreased fat in the arms and legs. The cause and long-term effects of these changes are not yet fully understood. Serious allergic reactions to this drug are rare but possible. Precautions: Before taking nelfinavir, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. If you are pregnant, inform your doctor before using this medication. Treatment can reduce the risk of transmitting HIV to your baby. However, this medication passes into breast milk and may have undesirable effects on a nursing infant. Breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication, as breast milk can also transmit HIV. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Nelfinavir can slow the removal of other medications from your body, potentially affecting their effectiveness. Similarly, other medications can affect how nelfinavir is removed from your body, altering its effectiveness. Examples include apalutamide, certain anti-seizure drugs (such as carbamazepine, phenobarbital, primidone), and rifampin. This medication may also reduce the effectiveness of hormonal birth control methods, such as pills, patches, or rings, potentially leading to pregnancy. Discuss with your doctor or pharmacist whether you should use reliable backup birth control methods while taking this medication. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Monitoring: While taking this medication, regular lab and medical tests (such as liver function, viral load, T-cell counts, triglycerides/cholesterol, and blood sugar) should be conducted. Keep all medical and lab appointments as scheduled. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication in its original container at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Note: This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
